searchText: The characteristics are basically that you can make an O(1) size witness for any arbitrary number of chunks And the main benefit of Merkle trees, the ability to quickly update witnesses when you quickly update the underlying data, does not really exist for contract code it would actually be interesting for code merklization to do dual-commitment: include both a Merkle root *and* a Kate commitment to the code in the account object that plus my gas cost change EIP ( https://notes.ethereum.org/@vbuterin/BkrNbeAfD ) would quickly get us to having acceptable stateless witness sizes
